darajoukar-reveal-rtl-reveal-rtl-rtl-sli.description: Create right-to-left HTML presentations (Persian/Farsi, Arabic) with reveal.js and the reveal-rtl plugins — correct RTL layout, Persian or Arabic digits, Jalali/Hijri dates, bundled Vazirmatn font, toolbar, speaker notes, PDF/PNG export. Use when the user asks for slides, a presentation, a deck or a talk in Persian or Arabic, or an RTL reveal.js presentation.
